policy.authority: Official publisher or issuing court only
policy.publicEvidenceRule: A source can support a published automated analysis only when the cited material is publicly reachable and its retained grain passes the newsroom safety gate.
policy.allegationRule: A complaint, indictment, press release or threat assessment is an official record of what an authority alleged or assessed; it is not an adjudication of guilt or proof of the alleged conduct.
policy.restrictedSystemRule: Restricted operational systems are registered as missing capabilities and are never represented as public evidence.
policy.safeGrainRule: Retain country, partner, broad precursor class, year and aggregate quantity only; exclude entities, addresses, live routing, synthesis routes, conversion ratios and yields.

capabilities.publisher: General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China
capabilities.title: China Customs Statistics

availability.access: Public web tables and releases; the English interactive-table surface is not a stable bulk API.
availability.recordGrain: Aggregate merchandise trade by period, commodity and partner where released

licensing.statement: Official statistics are publicly viewable, but NarcoScope has not identified terms authorizing bulk redistribution; link and cite unless permission is confirmed.

allowedClaims: The publisher makes official aggregate merchandise-trade statistics available.
No GACC product series is present in the current NarcoScope dossier.
prohibitedClaims: Aggregate customs statistics identify illicit end use.
Aggregate customs statistics identify a company, shipment or INCB incident.

availability.access: A keyless preview API is public and limited; free registered API access has quotas; bulk access and some redistribution require a subscription or licence.
availability.recordGrain: Reporter, partner, product classification, flow and period aggregates

licensing.statement: Use is governed by the UN Comtrade usage agreement; redistribution of large original extracts can require a separate licence, while transformed data is treated differently.

allowedClaims: UN Comtrade exposes official aggregate trade statistics by product and partner.
No Comtrade chemical-product extract is present in the current NarcoScope dossier.
prohibitedClaims: An HS aggregate establishes legal or illegal end use.
An aggregate row can be joined to a specific enforcement incident without a shared record identifier.

availability.access: Public annual PDF; selected aggregates retain printed page and paragraph locators, quantity relations and extraction derivations.
availability.recordGrain: Reported origin, destination, broad precursor class, reporting period, aggregate or incident count, quantity relation and basis

licensing.statement: Public UN publication; NarcoScope republishes a small attributed factual extract, not the report text.

allowedClaims: The report documents selected incidents or aggregates at the stated source grain and precision.
Operation Pseudonym reported China and India as origins in Australia and New Zealand without allocating the 168 seizures or their mass between either origin.
prohibitedClaims: Selected incidents estimate total trade or successful movement.
A reported origin establishes responsibility, intent or guilt.
Incident quantity can be converted into end-drug output.

availability.access: Secure system for registered government regulatory, customs, drug-control and law-enforcement users.

licensing.statement: Operational records are not a public dataset and are not licensed for NarcoScope redistribution.

allowedClaims: PICS is a restricted capability absent from this dossier.
prohibitedClaims: NarcoScope has searched or exhausted PICS.
Absence from the public report means absence from PICS.

availability.access: Secure pre-export-notification system for registered competent national authorities.
availability.recordGrain: Regulatory pre-export notifications for controlled precursor shipments

licensing.statement: Notification records are not a public dataset and are not licensed for NarcoScope redistribution.

allowedClaims: PEN Online is a restricted capability absent from this dossier.
prohibitedClaims: NarcoScope can verify a shipment's notification or authorization status in PEN Online.
No public PEN record means no notification existed.

capabilities.publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics
capabilities.title: VSRR Provisional Drug Overdose Death Counts

availability.access: Keyless Socrata API with a checked-in offline snapshot.
availability.recordGrain: US jurisdiction, 12-month-ending period and ICD-10 substance class

licensing.statement: US Government work; source attribution and provisional-data caveats are retained.

allowedClaims: The series describes provisional US mortality trends at the stated grain.
prohibitedClaims: Mortality rows identify a supplier, shipment, precursor or country of origin.
Temporal proximity establishes causation.

capabilities.publisher: US Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
capabilities.title: Specially Designated Nationals List

availability.access: Public list files with a checked-in privacy-minimized aggregate snapshot.
availability.recordGrain: Designated subject, program and country-of-record address; only aggregates enter the newsroom

licensing.statement: US Government work; NarcoScope excludes addresses, identifiers and other sensitive fields.

allowedClaims: OFAC took a published administrative action under a named program.
The aggregate counts records carrying China in OFAC's country-of-record address data.
prohibitedClaims: A designation is an adjudication of guilt.
Country of record establishes nationality.
A designation record is linked to an INCB incident or CDC death.

availability.access: Public report; narrative assessment rather than a record-level shipment dataset.
availability.recordGrain: Narrative national threat assessment with selected examples

licensing.statement: US Government work except where third-party material is identified; cite the report and do not treat narrative as a reusable shipment table.

prohibitedClaims: An agency assessment is an adjudicated finding.
Narrative scope can be silently converted into a complete incident series.

capabilities.title: Official case announcements and linked charging documents

availability.access: Public press releases and selected linked pleadings; disposition must be checked against the court docket.
availability.recordGrain: Case, defendant, charge, filing and stated procedural status

licensing.statement: DOJ-authored text is a US Government work; linked court filings can carry separate access and privacy considerations.

allowedClaims: DOJ announced a charge or filed allegation when quoted with its procedural status.
A conviction, plea, dismissal or judgment may be reported only from a disposition record.
prohibitedClaims: A complaint or indictment proves the allegation.
A press release alone establishes guilt or current case disposition.

capabilities.publisher: Administrative Office of the United States Courts
capabilities.title: Public Access to Court Electronic Records (PACER)

availability.access: Public registration is available, but searches and documents can incur fees; repeated automated access is restricted by PACER policy and sealed records are unavailable.
availability.recordGrain: Docket, filing, order, opinion and disposition by federal case

licensing.statement: Court records are public subject to sealing, privacy rules, access fees and PACER policy; this registry entry is not a bulk-redistribution licence.

allowedClaims: PACER is the authoritative docket capability and is absent from this automated build.
A checked judicial disposition can establish procedural outcome.
prohibitedClaims: The automated newsroom has exhaustively checked federal dockets.
A missing public filing establishes that no case or disposition exists.
